name: STISC new Tier III AI-ready government data center site search - Balti candidate area
developer: Serviciul Tehnologia Informatiei si Securitate Cibernetica (STISC)
notes: STISC's 2025 activity report records work on a feasibility study for creating a new data center and states that service trips for land identification were made to Ungheni district, Falesti district, and municipality of Balti. The same entry says the feasibility-study procurement was launched then cancelled to establish a new Tier III, AI-ready data-center concept and identify land matching Tier III requirements. A government decision draft/comment table separately changes the target from four new data centers to one new data center. No public evidence found that Balti was finally selected, that a permit was issued, or that MW capacity was disclosed.
